item.title: Review Overhaul – done-for-you Google review generation for local businesses
item.summary: Hey HN, I built Review Overhaul for local business owners who need more Google reviews but don't have time to chase them down manually. The problem I kept seeing: small businesses have happy customers but almost no reviews. Asking for reviews feels awkward, and most owners forget to follow up. You hand us your customer list once. We send a review request, then two follow-ups, then stop. No spam. We also set up and optimize their Google Business Profile and respond to every incoming review on their behalf. The interesting part was building the follow-up sequencing so it respects timing and doesn't hammer people. We guarantee 40 reviews in 90 days or we pause billing entirely — no credits, no fine print. Would love feedback from anyone who has dealt with local SEO or reputation management tooling.
